### US-010: Application configuration
- Expose the database URL, Stripe API key, and JWT signing secret to the application.
- Configuration is loaded when the module is first imported.
description: TypeScript twin of sec-03-hardcoded-secret. Production credentials (DB password, Stripe key, JWT signing secret) are committed as exported module constants. Any reader of the source, or of the bundle it compiles into, has full access. The values are the Python original's placeholders, so no secret scanner reads them as live keys; the planted flaw is the pattern.
expected_fix: Read the values from process.env or a secret manager at startup; never commit production credentials.
